It is a Secret Item that players can find hidden around the Dressing Room. The Babydoll Dress is a🟢Core Item. It is accessible to all players, regardless of when they started playing.

items.name: Cupcake Costume
items.description: The Cupcake Costume is a Clothing Item in Dress to Impress. It was added on October 25, 2024 during Halloween 2024. This item was used to replace the Hotdog Costume while it was temporarily removed and reworked due to inappropriate usage of the item. It is a Secret Item that players can find hidden around the Dressing Room. The Cupcake Costume is a🟢Core Item. It is accessible to all players, regardless of when they started playing.

items.name: Hotdog Costume
items.description: The Hotdog Costume is a Clothing Item in Dress to Impress. It was added on October 19, 2024 during Halloween 2024. On October 25, 2024, the Hotdog Costume was temporarily removed to be reworked due to inappropriate usage and was replaced with the Cupcake Costume. It returned on November 23, 2024, but now players can only customize it using patterns and palette colors. It is a Secret Item that players can find hidden around the Dressing Room. The Hotdog Costume is a🟢Core Item. It is accessible to all players, regardless of when they started playing.

items.name: Pineapple Glasses
items.description: The Pineapple Glasses is an Accessory Item in Dress to Impress. It was added on July 4, 2026 during Summer 2026 (Summer in Brazil). It is a Secret Item hidden in the Dressing Room. The Pineapple Glasses is a🟢Core Item. It is accessible to all players, regardless of when they started playing.
